title: Simultaneous recovery of various time-dependent coefficients in a hyperbolic equation with space-time nonlocal attenuation
summary: This article is devoted to the inverse problem of uniquely determining different classes of coefficients in a hyperbolic equation with space-time nonlocal attenuation from a local source-to-solution map. Our objective is to exploit the nonlocal attenuation mechanism to address inverse coefficient problems that remain open, or are even fundamentally intractable, for linear and nonlinear hyperbolic equations without attenuation. More precisely, by leveraging the interactions induced by nonlocal attenuation, we simultaneously determine general classes of leading and lower order coefficients…
